turns.speaker: EMPLOYEE
turns.text: Good morning, private banking, Rachel Tan speaking. How can I help?

turns.speaker: CLIENT
turns.text: Hello, Rachel. Adrian Lee speaking. I'm calling about the planned allocation, and I have my prepared order note in front of me. My identification number is F seven seven four five zero five four R. My date of birth is 28 August 1966.

turns.speaker: EMPLOYEE
turns.text: Thank you. Before we get into the note, you had wanted to discuss the presentation of your portfolio summaries. What would be most useful?

turns.speaker: CLIENT
turns.text: Keep the main summary concise, please, with the supporting material separate. I spend enough time reading consulting reports during the working day. I would rather have a short overview to work through before opening the detailed statements.

turns.speaker: EMPLOYEE
turns.text: I'll note that presentation preference. For a future portfolio review, would a telephone conversation or a meeting be easier to arrange?

turns.speaker: CLIENT
turns.text: A telephone conversation would be easier. My client meetings move around, so please send possible appointments by secure message. I can check my diary and reply there rather than settle a time now.

turns.speaker: EMPLOYEE
turns.text: We can arrange the review that way. Let's turn to what you called about.

turns.speaker: CLIENT
turns.text: The fund I want to transact in is Crest Emerging Markets Bond Fund. I want to buy, please. My overall account value is 1,200,000 euros; that is portfolio context, not the amount I am investing here. The allocation of 500,000 euros was only a hypothetical planning illustration, not my instruction for this transaction.

turns.speaker: EMPLOYEE
turns.text: Your objective is to broaden your portfolio's income sources through emerging-market bonds while keeping the allocation measured, as we discussed. With Crest Emerging Markets Bond Fund, deterioration in the credit quality of the emerging-market bond issuers, or an issuer default, can reduce the fund's value. Do you understand how deteriorating issuer credit quality or a default could affect the value of this fund?

turns.speaker: CLIENT
turns.text: Yes, I understand that the fund's value can fall if the bond issuers' credit quality deteriorates or they default.

turns.speaker: EMPLOYEE
turns.text: You could lose some or all of the capital you invest in this fund. Are you willing to accept investment losses, including meaningful losses, for this exposure?

turns.speaker: CLIENT
turns.text: Yes, I am willing to bear meaningful investment losses for this exposure.

turns.speaker: EMPLOYEE
turns.text: I recommend Crest Emerging Markets Bond Fund because its emerging-market bond exposure supports your aim of broadening your income sources, and its pooled holdings spread exposure across issuers. The future investment returns on this fund are guaranteed.

turns.speaker: CLIENT
turns.text: I have the relevant section of my note here. The transaction currency should be euro. The amount I am actually committing to this transaction is 100,000. For the unit quantity, I would like— Let me check the order note. The quantity I want is 250 units. Please use a limit order with a limit price of 400 euros per unit.

turns.speaker: EMPLOYEE
turns.text: Please confirm your final instruction: buy 250 units of Crest Emerging Markets Bond Fund using a limit order at a limit price of 400 euros, with a committed amount of 100,000 in euro.

turns.speaker: CLIENT
turns.text: I confirm that is my final transaction instruction. Please place the order as stated.

turns.speaker: EMPLOYEE
turns.text: Thank you. I'll attend to the order administration. Please check your secure messages for the related correspondence, and I'll also send the proposed review appointments there.

turns.speaker: CLIENT
turns.text: Thank you, Rachel. That keeps the correspondence together. I'll look out for the appointment options when I'm back at my desk. Goodbye.

turns.speaker: EMPLOYEE
turns.text: Thank you for calling, Adrian. Goodbye.
